# openinfra_subnet (Resource)

A topologically-isolated network segment (kube-ovn) — the AWS Subnet, enforced by OVN not NetworkPolicy. Requires the kube-ovn CNI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 CIDR, e.g. 10.20.0.0/24. Must not overlap other subnets. Immutable.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `acls` (Attributes List) Network ACL — stateless subnet rules (OVN), distinct from the stateful kind: SecurityGroup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acls))
- `allow_subnets` (List of String) CIDRs explicitly allowed to reach a private subnet.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP. Defaults to the first usable address in the CIDR.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces whose pods draw IPs from this subnet.
- `private` (Boolean) OVN-enforced isolation: only this subnet + allow_subnets may reach it. Public-facing (EIP/DNAT target) workloads need private=false.
- `vpc` (String) Parent kind: Vpc. Omit for the default VPC.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--acls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acls`

Required:

- `action` (String) allow or drop.
- `direction` (String) ingress (to workloads on this subnet) or egress (from them).

Optional:

- `cidr` (String) Peer CIDR — source for ingress, destination for egress.
- `match` (String) Raw OVN match expression — overrides the structured fields.
- `port` (Number) L4 destination port.
- `priority` (Number) Higher wins (0-32767). Default 1000.
- `protocol` (String) tcp, udp, icmp, or all (default).
